title: Steam local client data
whyItMatters: Steam keeps cached client state and a DPAPI key under LocalAppData. It shows the account was signed in and games were installed.
notes: The main account files (loginusers.vdf, userdata) sit in the Steam install directory under Program Files, which has no root token; this rule covers only reachable LocalAppData state. Unconfirmed: custom install directories are not matched.
